Elena (CFO): quick follow-up from the all-hands finance block: runway, approvals, and hiring rules. capturing answers here.
Diego (Eng): thanks  can you confirm runway? heard 14-18.
Elena (CFO): base-case runway ~16 months with current signed ARR; downside stress-case ~10 months if growth decelerates.
Priya (Sales): does base include signed Dedicated / reserved capacity deals?
Elena (CFO): yes  signed Dedicated contracts are included. New large reserved deals (> $500k ARR) are modelled in upside.
Marta (Hiring): what about offers in flight? pause?
Elena (CFO): not a full freeze. Only roles approved as "mission-critical" by the hiring committee proceed; others paused and reviewed weekly.
Diego (Eng): procurement thresholds for infra (GPUs/cloud)?
Asha (FinanceOps): effective immediately: < $25k = budget owner sign-off; $25k-$150k = budget owner + finance manager; > $150k = budget owner + finance director + CFO review + 1-page ROI for capital/prepay impact.
Diego (Eng): multi-year prepaid GPU instances (3yr)  how to approve quickly?
Elena (CFO): treat as > $150k. Include utilization plan, fallback/cancellation options, and a short ROI doc. Tag "customer-critical" if urgent.
Priya (Sales): discounting / pricing changes for Dedicated?
Sam (CEO): no blanket price increase; discount bands tightened for new deals. Sales ops will publish the updated playbook this week.
BudgetBot: automated: "Infra initiative: target 12% run-rate reduction in 90 days via batching, spot, and quantization pilots."
Asha (FinanceOps): procurement practicals: use https://redwood.internal/procure and include vendor, term, expected ARR impact, GL code. Incomplete forms will be returned.
Diego (Eng): any expedited path for customer-required on-prem appliances with long lead times?
Elena (CFO): yes  mark as "customer-critical" and loop Sales + Solutions + FinanceOps; we'll triage within 48 hours.
Asha (FinanceOps): action items: 1) Finance FAQ in #finance by EOD tomorrow; 2) procurement approval matrix updated; 3) hiring prioritization rubric published; 4) weekly Finance office hours for infra syncs.
Elena (CFO): drop follow-ups here or DM Asha/ me for sensitive items. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
